caveats: All ten are small independent auto-repair or tire/accessory shops with little or no web presence; scores are comparable within this batch and not with higher-ticket industries.
Ability-to-pay scores are inferred from review volume, service mix and premises. No financial data was checked.

Google Maps served a simplified 'limited view' layout for five listings (E & K Tire, California Speed & Sport, New Brunswick Auto Repairs, Nestor Garage, C&O Auto Service), hiding review counts; counts were cross-checked from 'People also search for' panels, Birdeye or Google search summaries and are labelled where unverified.

Some services and hours recorded for Google profiles were read from Google's AI Overview / knowledge panel on google.com search, which can be wrong; they are used as secondary confirmation, not proof of operations.
Where a rating shows but no review count (California Speed & Sport, E & K Tire, C&O), the count could not be verified on Google itself.
data_gaps: Azteca Auto Repairs' linked site (azteca-auto-repairs.jany.io) redirected to edan.io and returned a Cloudflare bot check, so its content, robots.txt and schema could not be assessed.
BBB profile for New Brunswick Auto Repairs returned HTTP 403, so accreditation, years in business and complaint history were not reviewed.

No official website could be confirmed for California Speed & Sport Shop - only third-party listings and Craigslist ads - so no site, robots.txt or schema review was possible; no Facebook page URL could be confirmed.
Google review counts were not displayed for E & K Tire Shop, California Speed & Sport Shop and C&O Auto Service; Birdeye/Loc8NearMe aggregates were used instead and may differ.

E & K Tire Shop has conflicting phone numbers (908-456-7335 vs 732-325-9662) in directories and a note that it may have moved; current address and phone were not independently confirmed beyond Google.

No phone numbers were dialled or verified, and no contact, quote or booking forms were submitted anywhere (read-only research). No page required a login or CAPTCHA except Azteca's linked template site, which was skipped.
